privacy.intro: ReKindle ist eine Webanwendung, die als Dashboard für E-Ink-Geräte entwickelt wurde. Wir legen großen Wert auf Ihre Privatsphäre und Transparenz.
privacy.retention.body:
Soziale Inhalte werden nach einer Aufbewahrungsfrist automatisch gelöscht: allgemeine KindleChat-Nachrichten (sowie ihre Übersetzungen und Galerieeinträge) nach 30 Tagen; Themenkommentare und Nachbarschaftsbeiträge nach 90 Tagen; ein altes Thema ohne verbleibende Kommentare wird entfernt. Erledigte oder verworfene Moderationsmeldungen, die älter als 90 Tage sind, werden gelöscht, automatisierte Moderationsprotokolle, die älter als 30 Tage sind, und Protokolle von Moderatoraktionen, die älter als 12 Monate sind. Direktnachrichten werden nicht automatisch gelöscht.

Du kannst dein Konto und seine Daten jederzeit unter Einstellungen > Konto löschen dauerhaft löschen. Dadurch werden dein Login, deine persönlichen Daten, deine sozialen Inhalte, Uploads und Bestenlisten-Einträge entfernt. Moderations- und IP-Sperrprotokolle können wie oben beschrieben aufbewahrt werden.
privacy.retention.title: Datenaufbewahrung
privacy.section.1.body:
ReKindle arbeitet in zwei Modi:

  • Gastmodus: Alle Daten werden lokal im Local Storage Ihres Browsers gespeichert. Es wird nichts an unsere Server gesendet. Wenn Sie den Browser-Cache leeren, gehen diese Daten verloren.
  • Angemeldeter Modus: Daten für unterstützte Apps werden sicher mit Google Firebase (Firestore & Realtime Database) unter Ihrer eindeutigen Benutzer-ID synchronisiert. Dies ermöglicht Ihnen den Zugriff auf Ihre Daten über mehrere Geräte hinweg.

Update (June 2026): We now operate two separate Firebase projects. A Primary project (rekindle-dd1fa) for most apps, and a Social project (rekindle-socials) for social features including KindleChat, Neighbourhood, Topics, Flipbook, Pixel Art, and Moderation.

Update (October 2026): The Social project now also stores KindleChat direct messages, the shared art gallery index, and moderation reports. Guest mode does not send account data to our servers, but apps may still contact the third-party services listed in Section 6. See the English version for full details.
privacy.section.1.title: 1. Datenarchitektur
privacy.section.2.body:
ReKindle bietet eine optionale Integration mit Google-Diensten, um Ihre persönlichen Daten auf Ihrem Gerät anzuzeigen.

  • Google Tasks: Wenn aktiviert, greift ReKindle auf Ihre Google-Aufgaben zu, um Ihre To-Do-Listen anzuzeigen und zu verwalten.
  • Google Kalender: Wenn aktiviert, greift ReKindle auf Ihren Google-Kalender zu, um Ihre Termine anzuzeigen und zu verwalten.
  • Google Kontakte: Wenn aktiviert, greift ReKindle auf Ihre Google-Kontakte zu, um Ihr Adressbuch anzuzeigen.
  • Zugriff: Die App fordert den Zugriff auf Ihre Google-Daten erst an, nachdem Sie ausdrücklich auf „Anmelden" geklickt und die Erlaubnis über das sichere OAuth 2.0-Protokoll von Google erteilt haben.
  • Verwendung: Diese Daten werden direkt von den Google-Servern in den Browser Ihres Geräts abgerufen. Sie werden ausschließlich zur Anzeige und Bearbeitung innerhalb des ReKindle-Dashboards verwendet.
  • Speicherung: Ihre Google-Aufgaben, Kalendertermine und Kontakte werden nicht auf unseren Firebase-Servern gespeichert. Temporäre Zugriffstoken werden im Local Storage Ihres Browsers gespeichert, um Ihre Sitzung aufrechtzuerhalten.
  • Aufbewahrung & Löschung: Wir halten uns an eine strikte Richtlinie der Datenminimierung. Da Google-Benutzerdaten nicht auf unseren persistenten Servern gespeichert werden, gibt es keine langfristige Aufbewahrung. Daten werden während Ihrer Sitzung lokal in Ihrem Browser zwischengespeichert und sofort gelöscht, wenn Sie sich abmelden oder den Browser-Cache leeren. Sie können den Zugriff von ReKindle jederzeit über die Sicherheitseinstellungen Ihres Google-Kontos widerrufen.
  • Weitergabe: Wir geben Ihre Google-Benutzerdaten nicht an Dritte weiter.

Die Nutzung und Übertragung von Informationen, die von Google APIs empfangen wurden, an eine andere App durch ReKindle erfolgt unter Einhaltung der Google API Services User Data Policy, einschließlich der Anforderungen zur eingeschränkten Nutzung.

Update (June 2026): We load the Google APIs Client Library (apis.google.com) for OAuth and service discovery. No tracking cookies are placed.
privacy.section.2.title: 2. Google-Benutzerdaten (Tasks, Kalender, Kontakte)
privacy.section.3.body:
Wir setzen branchenübliche Sicherheitsmaßnahmen ein, um die Vertraulichkeit und Integrität Ihrer sensiblen Daten zu gewährleisten.

  • Verschlüsselung bei der Übertragung: Alle Daten, die zwischen Ihrem Gerät, unseren Servern und Drittanbieterdiensten (einschließlich Google APIs) übertragen werden, sind mittels Transport Layer Security (TLS/SSL) verschlüsselt.
  • Verschlüsselung im Ruhezustand: Alle Daten, die mit unserer Datenbank synchronisiert werden (wie in Abschnitt 4 detailliert), werden auf Google Firebase (Firestore & Realtime Database) gehostet, welches Daten im Ruhezustand mit dem 256-Bit Advanced Encryption Standard (AES-256) verschlüsselt.
  • Sicherer Zugriff: Der Zugriff auf persönliche Daten ist auf den authentifizierten Benutzer beschränkt. Wir verwenden sichere Token (OAuth 2.0), um die Autorisierung zu verwalten, ohne Ihr tatsächliches Google-Passwort zu speichern.

Update (June 2026): We use OpenAI Moderation API for automated content scanning. IP bans and timeouts are enforced. Moderators can access user data for enforcement. Action logs retain moderated content. Age verification uses Firebase custom claims. See the English version for full details.

Update (October 2026): Reports and moderation records are stored in the Social Realtime Database and shared with the moderation team through a private Discord channel. Per-account rate-limit counters and short message hashes are used to prevent spam. See the English version for full details.
privacy.section.3.title: 3. Datenschutzmechanismen
privacy.section.4.body:
If you create a ReKindle account, the following app data is stored in our database (Google Firebase) to enable sync features across your devices. Social app data is stored in the separate rekindle-socials project; all other data is stored in the primary rekindle-dd1fa project:

  • Tasks & Quick ToDo: To-do items created in the main Tasks app or generated via handwriting in Quick ToDo.
  • Quick Notes: Notes created in Quick Notes, including text produced by handwriting recognition, with creation and update timestamps. Notes are also cached locally for offline display.
  • Calendar (Native): Events added to the native calendar if Google Calendar is not enabled.
  • Contacts (Native): Contacts added manually to the native address book if Google Contacts is not enabled.
  • Notes: The text content, formatting, timestamps, and sorting preferences of your notes.
  • Library: Your library index, reading progress (CFI position), daily reading duration, and personal book reviews/ratings. The actual book files are stored locally in your browser cache (IndexedDB) to save bandwidth, but the metadata is synced.
  • Settings: General preferences, wallpaper selection, integration toggles, display mode, auto-scaling, font preferences (including OpenDyslexic), unit system, and your custom AI API keys or third-party tokens (stored in a private pro_data collection for Pro users).
  • Mail (IMAP/SMTP): Your email account configuration (server addresses, ports, username, and password). Passwords are encrypted using AES-256 before storage. Email content is fetched directly from your mail server and is not stored on Firebase. Mail is available to ReKindle+ subscribers.
  • Clock: Your saved cities, alarms, and home location for the World Clock.
  • Crossword & Mini Crossword: Current puzzle state and grid progress.
  • Sudoku: Current puzzle state and pencil marks.
  • Nonograms (Picross): Puzzle progress and solved states.
  • Minesweeper: Current game state and timer.
  • Nerdle: Daily game state and guesses.
  • Chess & Checkers: Win/Loss/Draw statistics.
  • Leaderboards: High scores for Tetris, Snake, Pacman, Wordle, Spelling Bee, Dino, Maze, Tower of Hanoi, Lights Out, Trivia, Solitaire, Block Blast, Pet, Mario, Yahtzee, Perfect Circle, Crossy, Surfer, Jumpy, and Oregon Trail are visible to all signed-in users and linked to your username. Scores are written by our server after it validates the claimed value against a server-timed game run; the stored entry includes a server timestamp and a verified flag.
  • Interactive Reader: Your library of saved text adventures and reading progress.
  • Chords: Your saved songs and chord sheets.
  • Trivia: Your personal game history and statistics.
  • Habit Tracker: Your habits and completion history.
  • Stocks: The list of stock ticker symbols you are watching.
  • Cookbook: Recipes you save.
  • RSS Reader: Your subscribed feed URLs.
  • Substack: Your Substack session ID (SID) is encrypted using AES-256 before storage to enable access to your paid subscriptions.
  • Reddit: Your list of saved subreddits.
  • Flashcards: Your decks, cards, and study intervals.
  • Countdown: Your saved event timers.
  • Spelling Bee: Your daily found words and puzzle statistics.
  • Words (Scrabble): Multiplayer game state and turn history.
  • KindleChat: Messages sent in public chat rooms, including replies (which store a short snapshot of the message being replied to) and emoji reactions (which store your user ID, username and chosen reaction), are stored in the Realtime Database to facilitate high-performance instant communication. Your translation language preferences are also stored.
  • Neighbourhood: Your profile information, posts, comments, and connections with other users are stored to enable the community features. Your public profile may include: bio, pronouns, birthday, location, occupation, hometown, languages, favorite music/TV/movies, interests, travel history, social links, and pixel art avatar.
  • Freewrite: Active writing sessions and saved documents.
  • Mindmap: Saved mindmaps and layouts.
  • Suggestions: Your submitted suggestions, problems, upvotes, and comments.
  • Watchlist: Your saved movies and TV shows.
  • AirType: Your saved freewrite notes and writing sessions.
  • Pixel Art: Your saved drawings, canvas data, and manifest library.
  • Sheet Music: Your personal library of scores. (Note: Scores you explicitly upload to the 'Online Store' are public).
  • Flipbook: Your animations and drawing manifests are synced to enable cross-device editing.
  • Topics: Your saved topic subscriptions, reading preferences, and poll votes (the option you selected and when).
  • Food Log: Your categorized meals and daily food notes.
  • Journal: Your daily journal entries and reflections.
  • Live Multiplayer Games: Active game session state is stored in the Realtime Database for Chess, Checkers, Connect 4, Dots & Boxes, Pictionary, Tic-Tac-Toe, Uno, and Yahtzee.
  • Files & Docs: Your uploaded file metadata and text document drafts.
  • Teleprompter: Your saved speech scripts and scrolling preferences.
  • Spellbound: Your puzzle progress and stats.
  • Solitaire: Your saved game state and statistics.
  • Social Client Configs: Settings and access preferences for connected social platforms like Mastodon and Bluesky are securely stored if you authorize them.
  • Read Later: Your saved articles and reading list.
  • Life Calendar: Your life event entries and visual timeline data.
  • Age Verification: Your full date of birth (day, month, year) and country are stored to verify you meet the minimum age requirement for accessing social features. This data is retained for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Account Credentials: Your synthetic email address ({username}@rekindle.ink) and hashed password for authentication. You may change your password at any time.
  • User Profile: Your public username, avatar/profile picture (pixel art or generated), and join date.
  • Dashboard: Your favorite apps layout and homepage preferences.
  • Books: Your reading log, reading duration, and personal reviews.
  • Weather: Your saved locations and weather display preferences.
  • Chat (AI Assistant): Your AI chat presets and conversation preferences.
  • ePub Reader: Your ePub reader settings and preferences.
  • Pet: Your virtual pet state and progression.
  • Pool: Your single-player billiards game state.
  • Dropbox: Your Dropbox OAuth token and synced file metadata.
  • Security & Abuse Prevention: Your IP address is securely logged when registering and logging in. This is used strictly to enforce bans against serial offenders and prevent the creation of multiple accounts by abusive users. It is not used for external tracking or advertising.
  • KindleChat Direct Messages: Direct messages are stored in the separate rekindle-socials Realtime Database and are readable only by the two participants. Only ReKindle+ members can start a new conversation, and the recipient must accept it before messages can be exchanged. Each thread stores its participants, who requested it, its status (pending, accepted, declined or blocked), timestamps, and a per-participant index with the last message preview and your lastReadAt marker. Your allowRequests preference and your block list are stored so you can control who may contact you. Messages are text-only (up to 1,000 characters), screened by automated moderation, and may be reported; a report includes the reported message and up to the last 10 messages of that conversation for the moderation team. Direct messages are not end-to-end encrypted.
  • Shared Art Gallery: Pixel Art and Flipbook posts shared in KindleChat are added to a public gallery index visible to all age-verified users. The index stores your user ID, the art type, a thumbnail, any caption text and a timestamp. Removing the chat message or having it moderated removes it from the gallery.
  • Game Runs & Anti-Cheat: When you open a supported game, we record a run (user ID, game, random run ID, start time and last submission time). When you submit a score, the server validates it against your previous best and the elapsed time. Implausible submissions are logged in a score_audit collection with your user ID, the game, the field, the claimed value and the maximum allowed value. These records are used only to keep leaderboards fair.
  • Reports & Moderation: Reports you submit (your user ID and username, the reported user's ID, content type/ID/path, reason, comment, content snapshot, status and resolution) are stored in the Social Realtime Database and are readable by approved moderators. Reports are retained for moderation and audit purposes.
  • ReKindle+ Subscription: Your subscription status (isPro), expiry date, Stripe customer ID and subscription type (recurring or lifetime). Card and payment details are handled by Stripe and are not stored by ReKindle.
privacy.section.4.title: 4. Firebase Cloud Sync Daten
privacy.section.5.body:
The following apps store data only on your specific device via browser localStorage or IndexedDB (or are purely ephemeral), regardless of login status:

  • Browser: Your browsing history.
  • Language: Your completed units, lesson progress, and vocabulary stats.
  • Decide: Your saved decision options and lists.
  • Sketchpad (Napkin): Drawings are not saved to any persistent storage and are cleared upon exit or refresh.
  • ePub Reader: The ePub app is a tool for adding books to your main Reader library. It does not store data itself.
  • E-ink Sites: This app is a curated list of links and does not store any user data.
  • Pomodoro Timer: Your work/break durations, session count, current task label, and timer state are stored locally so a refresh does not lose your session.
  • Calculator & Converter: No data is stored.
  • Breathing: Session settings are ephemeral.
  • Single Player Games: 2048 (High Score & Game State), Wordle (Daily Progress), Jigsaw, Memory, Solitaire, Connections (Bindings), Word Search, Anagrams, Hangman, Blackjack (Chip Balance), Pool (8-Ball), Codebreaker, Doom, Yahtzee, Oregon Trail, Strands, Perfect Circle (personal high score), Pacman, Crossy, Jumpy, Surfer, and Cube Dash.
  • Pass-and-Play Games: Game State for 2-Player Battleship, Chess, Checkers, Connect 4, Tic-Tac-Toe, Texas Hold'em, and Pool is not synced to the cloud.
  • Freewrite: Host/Client connection codes are ephemeral and not stored permanently.
  • Scriptures: Reading progress, bookmarks, and selected translations.
  • Translate: Your recent translation history and target languages.
  • Comics (replaces the Manga app): Your comic library and reading progress are stored locally in IndexedDB. Comic metadata and page images are fetched from the Internet Archive.
  • Libby: Your linked library cards are stored locally; book content is fetched securely via Libby's interface.
  • Readwise: Your API token and saved highlights are stored locally.
  • Pinterest: Your OAuth tokens and search history are stored locally.
  • Photo Frame: Your display mode, interval, and layout preferences are stored locally. Uploaded photos are stored in Firebase Storage (see Section 4).
  • Stopwatch: Session state is stored in localStorage as part of the Timer app.
  • Newspaper: Your font size preference.
  • Scores (Sports): Your favorite teams and leagues for the Sports app.
  • Akinator: Game state (the current session and your answers) is kept only for the active game and is not saved after you leave the page.
  • Car Games: Your career progress, crew, and per-game state are stored locally.
  • Single-player Battleship, Connect 4, Dots & Boxes, Tic-Tac-Toe, and Uno: Game state is held only in memory and is lost when you leave or refresh the page.
  • Quick Notes (guest mode): Notes are stored locally. Signed-in notes sync as described in Section 4.
  • Life Calendar: Your birthday is cached locally so the calendar can render offline; signed-in users also sync it as described in Section 4.
privacy.section.5.title: 5. Nur lokale Daten
privacy.section.6.body:
ReKindle connects to the following third-party public APIs and services to provide functionality. These providers process requests under their own privacy policies:

  • Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and other LLMs: Used for the AI Assistant (Chat) intelligence. Your prompts are sent to these services via our secure proxy. Additionally, you may configure direct client-side connections to Groq, xAI (Grok), Mistral, Perplexity, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and local Ollama instances. These direct connections are user-configured and not proxied through our servers.
  • Cloudflare Workers: Used to proxy requests for the AI Assistant, Quick ToDo and Quick Notes handwriting recognition, translation services, and various API calls.
  • Cloudflare Workers AI: Used for OCR text extraction from images in Quick ToDo and Quick Notes. Base64-encoded images are sent to @cf/meta/llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct.
  • OpenAI Moderation: Used to check social content (messages, direct messages, pixel art and shared artwork) for policy violations.
  • Gutendex: Used by the Reader app to search for and download public domain ebooks.
  • Project Gutenberg: Used by the Reader's Gutenberg tab to search for and download public-domain books through our Gutenberg proxy.
  • Standard Ebooks: Used by the Reader's Standard Ebooks tab to fetch RSS feeds and book files. Requests are relayed through our Firebase Cloud Function because standardebooks.org blocks Cloudflare egress.
  • Open Library: Used for book search and cover images.
  • Google Books API: Used for book search.
  • DictionaryAPI & Wiktionary: Used by the Dictionary app for definitions.
  • Open-Meteo: Used for weather data and alerts.
  • Yahoo Finance: Used to fetch stock quotes.
  • CoinCap: Used to fetch cryptocurrency prices.
  • OpenStreetMap & Stadia Maps: Used by the Maps app for tiles, geocoding, and routing.
  • Reddit: Used to fetch public posts and comments.
  • Substack: Used to fetch public newsletter content and articles.
  • Dropbox: Used to sync files if you connect your Dropbox account.
  • Wikipedia & Wiktionary: Used to fetch daily history events and encyclopedia articles.
  • GitHub: Used as data sources for Crossword and Spelling Bee.
  • rss2json: Used by the Newspaper, Topics, and RSS Reader apps.
  • Open Trivia Database: Used by the Trivia app for questions.
  • CORS Proxies: Various CORS proxy services are used to fetch content from external sources that don't support cross-origin requests.
  • Stripe: Used to securely process payments for ReKindle+.
  • Beeper Desktop API: Used by the Beeper Connect app to interface directly with your local Beeper instance over your local network.
  • Mastodon & Bluesky APIs: Used by their respective client apps to view your social timelines and post updates directly to those federated networks.
  • Lingva.ml, LibreTranslate & Tatoeba: Used by the Translate app and KindleChat translation feature to process your text queries.
  • Internet Archive (archive.org): Used by the Comics app for public-domain comic search, metadata, covers, and page images.
  • Unsplash / Display APIs: Used by the Photoframe app to display randomized background images.
  • Readwise API: Used to fetch your saved highlights and reading list.
  • Pinterest API: Used to fetch your saved pins and boards.
  • Bible API: Used by the Scriptures app to fetch religious texts.
  • Quran API: Used by the Scriptures app to fetch Quran texts.
  • TMDB (The Movie Database): Used by the Watchlist app for movie/TV search and metadata.
  • ESPN: Used by the Scores app to fetch live sports scores, including NFL and NRL.
  • TheMealDB: Used by the Cookbook app for recipe search.
  • IFDB & IFArchive: Used by the Interactive Reader app for interactive fiction catalog and downloads.
  • GuitareTab: Used by the Chords app for guitar tab search.
  • DuckDuckGo HTML: Used by the Reader worker for article search.
  • NY Times: Used by the Wordle and Strands apps for daily puzzle data.
  • Iconify: Used for icon search and display.
  • QR Server: Used by the AirType app to generate QR codes.
  • Ko-fi: Used to display the donation leaderboard on the Supporters page.
  • IPify: Used to fetch your public IP address for IP ban enforcement checks.
  • Open Exchange Rates: Used by the Converter app for currency conversion rates.
  • Counter.dev: Used for anonymous page-view analytics across the site.
  • Akinator: Used by the Akinator game. Your yes/no answers and character guesses are sent to Akinator's servers (region-specific akinator.com domains) through our Firebase relay, with public CORS proxies as a fallback, so it can ask the next question. Akinator sessions are not linked to your ReKindle account.
  • Discord: Used by the moderation team. Report details (including reporter and reported usernames/IDs, content snapshots, report comments, and DM context) are sent to a private Discord channel, and moderators can action reports from Discord.

CDN Libraries: We load open-source JavaScript libraries from public CDNs including cdn.jsdelivr.net, cdnjs.cloudflare.com, unpkg.com, and gstatic.com. These libraries include Firebase SDKs, marked.js, chess.js, Dropbox SDK, localForage, JSZip, EPUB.js, Mammoth, docx, FileSaver, QRCode, html5-qrcode, gif.js, OpenSheetMusicDisplay, and Tone.js MIDI. These CDNs may log your IP address per their own policies.
